name: Discovery (STS 51-D)
about: Discovery (STS 51-D) (1985-028A), a crewed vehicle (OV-103), launched 1985 Apr 12. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (L).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1985 Apr 14), held fixed
GCAT names the site (KSC RW33); its coordinates are written from memory
